purpose: Measure whether fused AdamW reduces optimizer launch overhead while retaining the validated all-block activation recomputation policy
why: The original training state used fused AdamW; the pilot uses single-tensor AdamW. The separate pair-only recomputation experiment failed its strict gradient gate and is not adopted.
arithmetic_control: Four updates from identical real clipped FP16-training gradients and initial checkpoint weights; relative update L2 at most 0.02 and maximum parameter difference at most 2e-6. No training-trajectory equivalence claim.
profile: Same 128/64/32/16 batches at lengths 128/256/384/512; single-tensor versus fused AdamW, actual moment and EMA storage/arithmetic, learning rate zero, always self-conditioned stress; warm-up then four timed repeats per case
followup: Only if arithmetic controls pass and throughput improves at the unchanged batch size: run an actual matched short training trajectory before adopting the implementation in a new scientific experiment. Do not change the running recovery jobs.
